phase_definition: Mean of the two teams' observed current-season games before target, plus 1: early <=20, mid >20 and <=60, late >60. Observed archive ordinal, not an official ordinal.
tie_break: Fixed-seed random rank over sorted sample IDs; lexicographic selection ID tuple final tie-break
risk_policy: Known non-market/non-injury generation/factuality/binding failure with explicit regular-season game identity only. Numerical prediction-error extremes are excluded: never sample based on which model forecast was wrong.
